retail_taker.note: VIP-0 taker fee + 1bp half-spread + 1bp slippage per leg

optimistic_maker_bound.note: maker fee with BNB discount + 0.5bp; unattainable upper bound

capitalAssumption: Carry and rotation: 1.5 units of capital per unit notional (1 spot + 0.5 perpetual margin at 2x). Returns are on deployed capital, before tax.

experiments.hypothesis: Funding is not equally rich across assets. Holding the delta-neutral carry only in the asset whose trailing funding is highest, switching with hysteresis so costs do not eat the spread, should collect more carry per unit of capital than any single asset. Same payer as FUNDING_CARRY; the edge claimed is allocation, not prediction.
